parsed.post: Discarding the recent run (1.0209) as it was worse than my best (1.0179). It seems increasing depth to 6 might require a lower learning rate to stabilize. I'll try lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to see if it helps the deeper architecture converge better.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.03 to stabilize the DEPTH=6 architecture and seek further improvements.
